craft_notes: Sthāyin: worthy-only (withheld from base-cruel-nondevoted; given to thought-free heroes at guru's feet). Rows: row 2 (heroes→feet). Close: feet (the giving-place: at the feet, not to the hands). Rejected: softening base/cruel — killed: kept (the gate-words are the gate); 'deserving disciples' — killed: thought-free heroes kept (the verse's own qualifier: acintya-vīra, not merit).

lines: To another pupil, base, cruel, non-devoted:
but to thought-free heroes, lofty-souled — guru's feet.
l4.sanskrit_cite: paraśiṣye khale krūre abhakte gurupādayoḥ | nirvikalpamatīnāṃ tu vīrāṇām unnatātmanām

reads_against.argmap: To whom NOT to give? → Withheld from the unworthy, given to thought-free heroes only.
c1_essence: Withheld from base, cruel, non-devoted; to heroes given.
